item.title: This Lady LOVES to Chase Dogman and Bigfoot! (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Jessica Jones, better known as The Cryptid Huntress, is a paranormal investigator, cryptid researcher, and explorer of the unexplained. With a passion for uncovering the mysteries surrounding legendary creatures, Jessica has dedicated her investigations to the strange and often frightening encounters reported by eyewitnesses. From Dogman and Sasquatch to other mysterious entities lurking in the shadows, Jessica explores the possibility that our world is home to creatures and phenomena that science has yet to fully explain.

Through her work as The Cryptid Huntress, Jessica explores the connections between cryptid sightings, paranormal activity, and the supernatural. Her investigations examine eyewitness testimony, mysterious encounters, and theories about the origins of these elusive beings. With an adventurous spirit and a willingness to explore the unknown, Jessica brings an intriguing perspective to the world of cryptozoology, challenging audiences to question what may be hiding in the forests, mountains, and darkest corners of our world.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern. We broadcast LIVE every night. #UFO #UAP #AlienDisclosure #UFOSightings #UFOCoverUp #Aliens #SpacedOutRadio #Paranormal #UFOCommunity #disclosure
